title: Coherence characterizes constructible finite-module sheaves on vanishing topoi
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], and let $f:X\to S$ be of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and $F$ a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $V_f$ [def-trf-oriented-nearby-cycles]. Then $F$ is constructible in the finite-stratification sense of [def-trf-oriented-constructible-sheaf] if and only if its underlying sheaf of sets $|F|$ is a coherent object of $V_f$ in the sense of [def-trf-coherent-topos].
